title: Split packs.go into 3 files
description: Split the 2,577-line packs.go into 3 files: packs_core.go (~1,400 lines: types, handlers, install/uninstall, overlays, registry), packs_marketplace.go (~600 lines: marketplace catalog, download, HTTP client, version comparison), packs_validate.go (~550 lines: manifest parsing, tar extraction, JSON canonicalization, merge patch, hash). Delete original packs.go after split. Build after each step.

implementationPlan.description: Create packs_validate.go: Extract validation/extraction/normalization functions (lines 1907-2537): loadPackBundleFromReader, loadPackManifest, validatePackManifest, ensureProtocolCompatible, ensureCoreVersionCompatible, parseSemver, compareSemver, shouldSkipConfigOverlay, hasPoolOverlay, validate*Patch, extractPools, load*File, normalizeWorkflowMap, hash*, workflowToMap, normalizeJSON, deepCopy, mergePatch, buildDeletePatch, canonicalJSON, appendCanonical*, isTarGz, exists, findPackRoot, extractTarGzReader, safeJoin.

Create packs_marketplace.go: Extract marketplace logic — errMarketplaceNotFound+seedDefaultPackCatalogs (64-131), marketplace types (314-406), marketplace handlers (458-611), marketplace functions (937-1412): marketplaceSnapshot, loadMarketplaceEntries, loadPackCatalogs, fetchMarketplaceCatalog, buildMarketplaceResponse, findMarketplaceEntry*, compareVersions, normalizeVersion, parseVersion, downloadPackBundle, validateMarketplaceURL, marketplaceHTTP*, hostFromURL, marketplaceAllowedHosts.

Create packs_core.go from remaining packs.go: package+imports+constants (1-62), pack types (133-312), core handlers (407-457, 612-936), planning/overlay/registry functions (1413-1906), lock helpers (2538-2577). Delete original packs.go.
Build and test: go build ./... and go test ./core/controlplane/gateway/... -count=1
